question.problem: Given the function $f(x,y,z,w) = xyzw,$ compute $\nabla_{x,w} \: f.$
question.worked_solution:
To compute $\nabla_{x,w} \: f$, we take partial derivatives with respect to $x$ and $w$ only.

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x}=\frac{∂}{∂x}(xyzw) & =yzw \\ \frac{∂f}{∂w}=\frac{∂}{∂w}(xyzw) & =xyz\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{∇}_{x,w}\,f & =[\begin{aligned}\frac{∂f}{∂x} \\ \frac{∂f}{∂w}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}yzw \\ xyz\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$
